versionLabel: Version 3.5 - JP Morgan AI factor enhancement

assumptions.data: Adjusted daily public US stock histories with ETF risk-factor overlays
assumptions.jpMorganEnhancement: Version 3.5 adds a shared JP Morgan-inspired AI factor score across momentum, quality, low-vol, liquidity, regime and crowding controls.

coreModels.name: V1 Momentum-Vol Research Model
coreModels.note: Version 3.5 - JP Morgan AI factor enhancement: 252-day stock momentum plus JP Morgan-style quality, low-vol and crowding controls; top 3; 10.0% vol target

coreModels.name: V2 HMM-GARCH-MVO
coreModels.note: Version 3.5 HMM-GARCH-MVO: two-state regime model, GARCH risk forecast, capped MVO, and JP Morgan AI factor expected-return adjustment.

coreModels.name: V3 Boosted Trees + Attribution
coreModels.note: Version 3.5 walk-forward boosted stumps with JP Morgan AI factor features, regime/liquidity/crowding inputs and additive feature attribution.

strategies.name: S1 AI Capex Momentum+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 JP Morgan AI infrastructure strategy: capex momentum plus AI factor confirmation, liquidity/risk penalty, volatility targeting and hedge sleeve.

strategies.name: S2 Quality Growth Barbell+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 quality-growth barbell: quality proxy, AI factor score, growth acceleration, low-vol hedge that expands during market stress.

strategies.name: S3 Crowding-Aware Momentum+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 anti-crowding momentum: JP Morgan-style crowding, liquidity and one-month chase penalties.

strategies.name: S4 Low-Vol Alpha Shield+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 low-vol alpha shield: medium trend plus quality, drawdown, low-vol and crowding-aware JP Morgan controls.

strategies.name: S5 Regime-Switch Equity Hedge+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 regime hedge: JP Morgan macro regime, liquidity, credit and volatility stress decide equity/hedge budget.

strategies.name: S6 Credit-Liquidity Accelerator+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 credit-liquidity accelerator: high-yield/Treasury proxy plus JP Morgan liquidity and regime score before increasing beta.

strategies.name: S7 Revision-Proxy Growth Rank+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 revision proxy: acceleration, AI factor score, quality and volatility stability proxy analyst-revision behavior.

strategies.name: S8 Trend-Guarded Reversion+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 guarded reversion: pullback entries require trend, drawdown, volatility and JP Morgan crowding controls.

strategies.name: S9 Sector-Breadth Rotation+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 sector-breadth rotation: ETF breadth/factor leadership plus JP Morgan regime, liquidity and quality scoring.

strategies.name: S10 Defensive Growth Stabilizer+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 defensive stabilizer: quality, low-volatility, crowding control and volatility stress hedge.

strategies.name: S11 Tail-Risk Shock Absorber+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 tail-risk absorber: JP Morgan regime, low-vol and quality score before shifting into hedges under shock.

strategies.name: S12 Adaptive Volatility Compounder+
strategies.note: Version 3.5 adaptive volatility compounder: dynamic target volatility plus JP Morgan liquidity, regime and low-vol scoring.
